about_short_description.short_description: Wattvision helps users save money on energy by providing them with live feedback on their energy use, on the web or mobile phones.

product.name: Energy Use Monitoring Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that collects and visualizes live energy consumption data from various sensors for homes, businesses, and rental properties.

product.name: Live Energy Use View
product.description: A feature that displays current energy consumption updated every 10 seconds for real-time monitoring.

product.name: Bill View
product.description: A tool to create custom energy bills for personal use or tenant billing with configurable pricing periods.

product.name: Weekly History View
product.description: A heat-map visualization showing weekly energy usage to identify efficient and inefficient days.

product.name: Monthly History View
product.description: A monthly overview displaying daily energy consumption totals to track usage trends over time.

product.name: Daily View in Kilowatt-hours
product.description: A comparison tool showing daily energy use in kilowatt-hours against previous days.
